1417-1939-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1417-1939-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2527-4076-4279-4446-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4446-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3899-3991-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-6441-6753-6763-7942.description:

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2744-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave  by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.

1453-2387-3490-4460.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-4460.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5003-7293.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Palani's Hatcher, adding {C}{C}.
When Palani's Hatcher dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Palani's Hatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Palani's Hatcher enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2292-6517-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.

273-3497-7070.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
273-3497-7070.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Shuko ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.

1978-3488-4563.description:
Animate Everflowing Chalice using Katsumasa.
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat from step 2.

413-465-3817.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2438-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2438-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast a creature spell with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in its mana cost.

Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.

Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, causing you to untap Helga.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-1671-3314-3430-5478.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {U}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-1671-3314-3430-5478.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2741-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-5231-5997-6753.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

149-2464-4831.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.

149-2464-4831.description:

Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2393-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2393-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

813-2104-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Cloudshift.
813-2104-3603.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2018-2829-5570.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Nardole.
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Nardole didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Nardole from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

2438-3951-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2438-3951-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.

116-1719-4639.description:

Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1263-2018-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 5
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

175-3525-4678.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3525-4678.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

2034-3996-5115.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3996-5115.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

717-779-1385-4279-4680.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
717-779-1385-4279-4680.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel.
The Hollow Sentinel dies, triggering Zulaport Cutthroat, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-3081-4283.notablePrerequisites:
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Whisper.
You control two additional Cleric creatures with different mana values.
An additional Cleric creature card in the graveyard with a higher mana value than the other two.
2178-3081-4283.description:
Activate Whisper using its own ability by tapping it and sacrificing your two additional Cleric creatures.
Whisper's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers twice and Orah triggers twice, but one of Orah's triggers has no valid target.
Resolve one Whisper trigger, untapping Whisper.
Resolve Orah's trigger, returning the sacrificed Cleric with the lowest mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Whisper's ability, returning the Cleric with the highest mana value from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Whisper using its own ability by tapping it and sacrificing your two additional Cleric creatures.
Whisper's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers twice and Orah triggers twice.
Resolve one Whisper trigger, untapping Whisper.
Resolve both Orah triggers, returning two Cleric creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Whisper's ability, returning any creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have no non-Cleric creature cards in your graveyard, you may choose the same Cleric with both Orah triggers in step 7 to avoid running out of valid Whisper targets, or you may sacrifice a non-Cleric creature to Whisper.
Resolve all Whisper triggers from the Thornbite Staff ability, untapping Whisper any number of times.
